title: Regular etale scalar unit as exact adjunction insertion
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings in the coefficient universe, let φ : A → B be a unital ring map, and let T be any scheme. For the published ordinary-etale derived scalar extension and its representative-normalized unit isomorphism [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], transport the unit hom along the canonical single/unit isomorphisms on both sides. The resulting arrow is the exact adjunction insertion [def-sp-exact-degree-zero-adjoint-interface], using the published derived adjunction to actual restriction of scalars, of the ordinary lax restriction unit. There is no flatness, boundedness or finite-type hypothesis.

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3, ordinary regular-unit normalization and passage to derived coefficients

proof.text: The ordinary oplax unit of sheafified scalar extension is the adjunction transpose of the ordinary lax unit of restriction. Apply the ordinary hom equivalence to its inverse to identify its adjunct with that lax unit.

The published unitIso has its UnitNormalization property. Its cochain representative is definitionally the representative formed from the same ordinary and derived scalar adjunctions. Apply the normalized exact-single adjunction comparison to this normalization and the ordinary unit identity.

proof_origin.place: P2: ordinary monoidal adjunction unit and specialization of the proved normalized representative/single comparison

theorem scalarUnit_eq_adjointInsertion
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (Etale.scalarExtension φ T).map
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctorObjUnitIso
          (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))).hom ≫
      (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ T).hom ≫
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctorObjUnitIso
          (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))).inv =
      SheafExactDegreeZero.adjointInsertion
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ)
        (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ))
        (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ))
